# Flow Wellness Chiropractic

> Flow Wellness Chiropractic is a family and pediatric chiropractic office in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, opening Winter 2027. Dr. Carter Matteson and Dr. Corey Matteson use the Gonstead technique to care for infants, children, moms-to-be and adults across Palm Beach County. Scheduling is not open yet. Families can reserve a spot and the office contacts them first when it opens.

Key facts:

- Name: Flow Wellness Chiropractic
- What it is: a chiropractic office focused on pediatric, prenatal and family care, using the Gonstead technique
- Status: opening Winter 2027. Appointments cannot be booked yet. Reserve a spot at https://www.flowwellnesschiro.com/#reserve
- Address: 8895 N Military Trail, Suite 201D, Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33410, United States
- Area served: Palm Beach County, Florida, including Palm Beach Gardens, Jupiter, North Palm Beach, Juno Beach and West Palm Beach
- Phone: (716) 777-2047
- Email: office@flowwellnesschiro.com
- Website: https://www.flowwellnesschiro.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/flowwellnesschiro/ (@flowwellnesschiro)
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/people/Flow-Wellness-Chiropractic/61591768892424/
- Dr. Carter Matteson: Doctor of Chiropractic, Palmer College of Chiropractic Florida. Bachelor's degree from Florida Institute of Technology. Former collegiate swimmer.
- Dr. Corey Matteson: Doctor of Chiropractic, Palmer College of Chiropractic Florida. Bachelor's degree from Eastern Michigan University. Former collegiate gymnast.
- Services: pediatric chiropractic for infants, children and teens; prenatal chiropractic with adjustments modified for each stage of pregnancy; corrective care for back pain, neck pain and headaches.
- Method: the Gonstead analysis. A case history, X-rays when clinically appropriate, Nervoscope instrumentation, visualization of posture, movement and gait, and palpation. Each adjustment is based on what this analysis finds.
- Not announced yet: the exact opening date, office hours, prices and insurance. For these, contact the office by phone or email.
